title: HR Business Partner
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Position Overview**

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) will serve as the primary HR partner for a large strategic client account, supporting approximately 400-500 employees across multiple project sites and offices. The role will work closely with project leadership, operational managers, employees, client stakeholders, and HR partners to deliver people solutions that support project delivery, workforce effectiveness, employee engagement, and a positive employee experience.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Business Partnership

* Partner with Account Leadership, Project Managers, and Functional Leaders to support business objectives through effective people solutions.
* Provide HR guidance on workforce planning, staffing requirements, resource deployment, and talent retention.
* Support leaders in managing team performance, employee development, and organizational effectiveness.
* Act as a trusted advisor on employee-related matters, balancing business priorities with employee experience and engagement.
* Use workforce insights and employee feedback to identify trends and recommend actions that improve performance, retention, and workforce effectiveness.

Employee Relations & Workforce Management

* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee relations matters across project sites and office locations.
* Proactively identify and address workplace concerns, employee issues, and team dynamics before they escalate.
* Conduct and support investigations into employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace conflicts, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution.
* Coach managers on employee relations, performance management, and effective people leadership practices.
* Monitor workforce trends and provide recommendations to improve employee engagement, retention, and workplace culture.
* Support organizational change, workforce transitions, and project-related people impacts.

HR Advisory & Employee Support

* Serve as the primary HR contact for managers and employees across the account, providing guidance on AECOM policies, practices, programs, systems, and people processes.
* Support managers in the consistent application of performance management, talent, compensation, employee relations, and workforce management practices.
* Advise employees on HR policies, benefits, employee programs, career-related processes, and available support resources.
* Partner with HR Operations and wider HR teams to ensure timely resolution of employee and manager inquiries.
* Promote understanding and adoption of AECOM's people policies, systems, values, and organizational practices across project teams and locations.
* Act as an advocate for both the business and employees while ensuring alignment with company policies and governance requirements.

Employee Engagement & Retention

* Develop and implement engagement initiatives aligned with the specific needs of the account workforce.
* Partner with managers and leaders to foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
* Analyze employee feedback, survey results, retention data, and workforce insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support wellbeing, recognition, inclusion, and employee experience initiatives across the account.
* Drive engagement activities across multiple sites and locations while ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving retention, manager effectiveness, employee development, and workforce morale.

Project & Client Support

* Collaborate with project leadership to support workforce mobilization, onboarding, deployment, and project staffing requirements.
* Provide HR support during project ramp-ups, expansions, organizational changes, and workforce transitions.
* Interface with client representatives, where required, on people-related matters that impact project delivery and workforce effectiveness.
* Support workforce reporting, people analytics, and account-level metrics required by business and project leadership.
* Ensure people considerations are effectively integrated into project planning and delivery activities.

HR Operations & Compliance

* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies, procedures, and HR programs across all project locations.
* Partner with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards, and other HR functions to deliver integrated HR solutions.
* Support recruitment efforts and workforce planning activities in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and business leaders.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, client obligations, and company governance standards.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, workforce documentation requirements, and risk management activities.

Stakeholder Management

* Build strong relationships with account leaders, project managers, site leadership teams, employees, and HR colleagues.
* Establish credibility as a responsive and trusted HR partner across geographically dispersed teams.
* Support communication, change management, and employee engagement initiatives across the account.
* Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to support strategic workforce outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 10-15 years of progressive HR experience, preferably within engineering, infrastructure, consulting, construction, manufacturing, or other project-based environments.
* Proven experience as an HR Business Partner supporting large, distributed, multi-site workforces.
* Strong experience in employee relations, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting client-facing operations, strategic accounts, or project-based businesses is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and build strong partnerships across multiple organizational levels.

Additional Information

* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, employment practices, and HR governance requirements.
* Experience managing complex employee relations matters, investigations, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Strong communication, facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
* Experience supporting geographically dispersed and multi-location workforces is highly desirable.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites, client locations, and regional offices to support employees, leaders, and business priorities.

  
**Additional Information**

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Receptionist, Admin & HR - Gandhinagar
description:
We are looking for a professional, organized, and people-oriented **Receptionist, Admin & HR Executive** to manage front-office operations, administrative activities, and basic HR functions. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a pleasant personality, strong organizational abilities, and the ability to handle confidential information professionally.

**1. Reception & Client Coordination**

* Manage the reception desk and greet clients, visitors, candidates, and other stakeholders professionally.
* Handle incoming calls, emails, messages, and correspondence and direct them to the appropriate Partner or team member.
* Coordinate client visits, appointments, meetings, and conference-room schedules.
* Maintain visitor records and ensure appropriate visitor access.
* Handle incoming and outgoing courier, post, and documents.
* Coordinate the movement and distribution of client-related documents within the office.
* Maintain a professional, clean, and welcoming reception area.
* Provide basic information about the firm and direct client queries to the appropriate team.
* Maintain a high level of client service and professional etiquette at all times.

**2. Office Administration**

* Manage day-to-day administrative activities of the office.
* Maintain office records, registers, files, documentation, and administrative databases.
* Coordinate stationery, office supplies, printing, courier, housekeeping, security, and other office requirements.
* Monitor office inventory and ensure timely replenishment of essential supplies.
* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, building management, and maintenance agencies.
* Assist in organizing internal meetings, training sessions, seminars, client meetings, and office events.
* Coordinate travel, accommodation, and other administrative arrangements for Partners and employees when required.
* Maintain office-related bills, invoices, and supporting documents and coordinate with the accounts team for processing.
* Ensure smooth functioning of office facilities and promptly escalate maintenance or operational issues.
* Assist Partners and senior management with administrative requirements.

**3. HR Coordination & Employee Support**

* Assist with end-to-end recruitment coordination, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, and follow-ups.
* Coordinate interviews with Partners and department heads.
* Handle candidate communication and joining formalities.
* Prepare and maintain employee personnel files and HR documentation.
* Coordinate onboarding and induction of new employees.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave, and other HR records.
* Collect and coordinate payroll-related inputs such as attendance, leave, new joiners, exits, and employee changes.
* Prepare HR letters, employment-related documents, internal notices, and other HR correspondence.
* Assist in employee engagement activities, celebrations, training programs, and internal events.
* Respond to routine employee queries and coordinate with management/HR for resolution.
* Assist in maintaining HR policies, procedures, and employee records.
* Support employee exit formalities and maintain appropriate documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality of employee, client, and firm-related information.

**4. Compliance & Confidentiality**

* Maintain strict confidentiality of client information, employee records, financial information, and internal firm matters.
* Ensure proper filing and safe custody of sensitive documents.
* Follow the firm's internal policies, procedures, and professional standards.
* Ensure that confidential documents are not shared with unauthorized persons.
* Maintain appropriate records required for internal administration and HR purposes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, BA, BMS, HR, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in Reception, Administration, HR, or a combination of these functions.
* Experience in a CA firm, professional services firm, consultancy, law firm, or similar corporate environment will be preferred.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook/email.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good English communication and professional telephone etiquette.
* Ability to handle confidential information with maturity and discretion.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Professional communication and client-handling skills
* Strong organizational and coordination abilities
* Front-office and visitor management
* HR administration and recruitment coordination
* Documentation and record management
* Good command of MS Office
* Multitasking and prioritization
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability
* Professional appearance and conduct
* Teamwork and interpersonal skills
* Confidentiality and integrity
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines

**Preferred Candidate**

The ideal candidate will be **well-groomed, approachable, proactive, responsible, and comfortable handling multiple responsibilities across Reception, Administration, and HR functions.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Executive, IT User Support
description:
**Description:**

The role is responsible for ensuring effective day\-to\-day technical support to employees across a range of hardware and software systems. The role focuses on independently diagnosing complex user issues, performing advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification, and ensuring timely and high\-quality resolution of user problems, queries, and complaints. The role manages end\-to\-end incident resolution, supports root cause identification, and ensures proper escalation and coordination with internal or external support teams when required. The role emphasizes service reliability, adherence to SLAs, user satisfaction, and compliance with IT policies and information security standards.  



  

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide advanced user support for hardware and software issues
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems independently
* Perform detailed troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Coordinate and manage escalations with internal/external teams
* Ensure timely closure of incidents as per SLAs
* Document issues, resolutions, and root causes
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and security standards
* Guide junior support staff when required

### **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES –**

* **Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery:** Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* **Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics:** Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including **LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems** , ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* **Plant IT Infrastructure:** Own and manage plant\-level **LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure** to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* **Information Security:** Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* **Regulatory Compliance \& Audits:** Act as the **Plant IT SPOC** for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with **GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements** .
* **IT Governance \& SOP Management:** Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT **SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks** in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* **IT Projects \& Digitization:** Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* **Vendor \& Partner Management:** Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* **Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery:** Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of **backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity** solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Work closely with **Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions** to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* **IT Service Performance:** Monitor Plant IT performance through **SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction** , ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* **Technology \& Infrastructure Planning:** Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on **IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization** across the plant.
* **CSV / Computerized System Compliance:** Provide support for **computerized system validation lifecycle activities** , including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities for **process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization** to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  
**Education:*** Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) B.Tech \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) M.Tech \- Preferred

**Experience:*** 5 years or more in 5 \- 8 Years

**Specialized Knowledge:** **Licenses:**

description:

1\.



Strategic Talent Acquisition

Compliance \& Documentation
